summary: Equities stabilized Thursday as breadth broadened beyond mega-cap tech, with equal-weight shares outpacing the S&P 500 and staples outperforming growth. Treasuries firmed alongside a steady curve, while gold and bitcoin both found modest footing after a shaky prior session, leaving overall risk sentiment in neutral territory.
tweet: Thursday's session showed broadening equity participation and firmer bonds, with gold and crypto stabilizing as sentiment held neutral.
